hello.title: Hi! I'm Chai
hello.text: I'll help you start speaking English, without cramming or boring textbooks.

lessons.title: 5 minutes a day
lessons.text: Short lessons matched to your level, from A1 to C1. XP and a daily streak keep you going.

talk.title: Speak out loud
talk.text: AI teachers are available 24/7. They correct mistakes gently and switch to Russian if you get stuck.

install.title: Add Talkreal to your Home Screen
install.text: It will open like a regular app.

home.greeting: Good to see you! Ready for some English?
home.lessonText: Lessons will appear here very soon.

talk.title: Teachers
talk.subtitle: Live voice conversations are coming very soon. Meanwhile, meet the team.

harper.style: Warm and precise. Explains a rule so that it finally sticks.

jake.style: Relaxed and fun. Small talk, slang and phrases from real life.

elena.style: Explains in Russian when it gets hard. Ideal if you're just starting.

sterling.style: Interviews, calls and negotiations. Clear and to the point.

install.title: Install the app on your iPhone
install.step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen
